profile.headline: Software Engineer- Clinical Architecture
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience building and maintaining web applications across full-stack environments, with a focus on problem solving, usability, and scalable architecture. Experienced working with JavaScript, C#, .NET, Vue.js, Node.js, and SQL-based systems, along with modern tooling and Agile development practices.

I enjoy digging into complex bugs, improving workflows, and building tools that make systems easier to maintain and teams easier to support. I’ve worked closely with QA, product management, and other developers to research issues, refine requirements, and deliver practical solutions across enterprise applications.

Outside of day-to-day development, I’m interested in process improvement, UI/UX considerations, AI-assisted workflows, and building personal projects that combine data, automation, and community engagement.

positions.title: Taproom Captain
positions.description:
•	Opened a new Sun King location as a part of the first management team.
•	Trained a group of 60 new employees prior to opening day in order to ensure smooth operation.
•	Perform opening and closing duties, including: counting money, ensuring cleanliness, and managing our team.
•	Service customer problems in person and on the phone to professionally ensure a good experience.
•	Address employee challenges and provide assurance in order to keep them motivated throughout their shifts.
•	Write the weekly news email in order to inform the staff about new beers, events, and promotions.
•	Expedite food using strong attention to detail in order to provide correct orders to customers in a timely manner.
•	Extract financial data nightly to provide proper sales numbers to upper management.
•	Count inventory of merch and office supplies and provide forecasts for proper levels of supplies on hand.
•	Communicate company needs on a daily basis with upper management in shift notes at the end of the day.

positions.title: Podcast Producer
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with business partners to invite and create a podcast showcasing the entrepreneurs in Indianapolis.
•	Wrote a script based on research of our current week’s guest in order to have a clear storyline for that episode.
•	Utilized audio equipment and learned equipment quickly to solve any problems on a weekly basis.
•	Recruited other content creators looking to record their own content in the studio in order to increase revenue.
•	Coordinated weekly projects by planning, writing, recording, and solving technological problems in the process.
•	Scheduled potential influencers a month in advance in order to have an organized calendar of shows.

positions.title: Communications Intern
positions.description:
•	Constructed email newsletters with Salesforce Marketing Cloud in order to keep our customers updated.
•	Composed and analyzed content on social media and blogs for both the SAVI database tools.
•	Managed multiple projects for social media, research, and database education to better advertise those services.
•	Analyzed monthly data and metrics to make adjustments for Digital Marketing practices in the organization.
•	Designed and maintained monthly editorial calendars to keep all social media organized and separate.
•	Attended monthly training on data analytics for better understanding of the SAVI tool for social media.
•	Utilized WordPress, Hootsuite, and other CMS sites to post blogs, social media posts, and analyze data.

positions.title: Student Government Representative
positions.description:
•	Attend Biweekly Kelley Indianapolis Student Government meetings and advocate for Kelley Indy Cares.
•	Update and vote on constitutional changes with regards to the organization and to promote participation.
•	Provide Student Government assistance to the fellow executive board members regarding financial issues.
•	Participate in 5 hours of Biweekly community service activities in Indianapolis: Gleaners, Wheeler, etc.

positions.title: Chair of Communications- Marketing Committee
positions.description:
•	Build and implement ideas for the Jagathon marketing campaign, including printing and planning posters.
•	Implement ideas for special marketing for the Jagathon event, including lanyards, popsockets, stickers, etc.
•	Assist Director of Marketing in promoting the Jagathon event by completing tasks given on a weekly basis.
•	Develop new ways of Marketing the Jagathon event on the Internet utilizing JagNews, and Social Media.
•	Develop guerilla marketing on campus: examples include a big Post-It note “FTK” in the Campus Center Atrium.
•	Participate in community service in order to raise donations including the Indianapolis Monumental Marathon.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
•	Planned events for residents within the hall, average attendance of 60 residents a month out of a total 120. 
•	Developed agendas for weekly meetings, and delegated the responsibility to fellow Hall Council members.
•	Attended a weekly Residence Hall Association Meeting, and helped planned school-wide residential programs.
•	Led and delegated duties to other members of the Residence Hall Council such as making and posting advertisements, knocking on doors, and providing word of mouth to residents for maximum participation in events.

positions.title: Independent Distributor
positions.description:
•	Worked approximately 30 hours per week in the mornings providing reliable service for customers.
•	Collected bundles of newspapers on a daily basis and sorted newspapers by address for proper delivery.
•	Delivered to customers and called customers if there was more clarification needed for their orders.
•	Provided special customer service, getting to know customers, and providing access to their paper.
